DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 転入の確認が終わりました。関連手続きの一覧をお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Your move-in registration has been checked. Here is a list of related procedures.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この一覧を全部今日やるのでしょうか。子どもの項目もありますが、私は一人暮らしです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 関連一覧を全項目実施か質問し単身状況を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Do I have to do everything on this list today? It includes items for children, but I live alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether every item on the related-procedure list is required and explain that you live alone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 全ての方が全ての項目を行うわけではありません。状況に合わせて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Not everyone needs to complete every item. We will check according to your circumstances.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。子どもはいません。会社で働いていますが、保険については会社へ確認中です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 子なし就労中と保険回答未到着を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. I have no children. I work for a company, but I am still checking with them about insurance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have no children, are employed, and have not yet received an answer about insurance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 保険の状況は、担当窓口で確認しましょう。会社の回答がまだ出ていないことをお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check your insurance situation at the relevant counter. Please tell them your company has not answered yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自分で加入先を決めたようには言いません。ほかに今日確認しておくとよい項目はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 加入先未確定として必要項目を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't say that I have already decided which insurance to enroll in. Is there anything else I should check today?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask which items are necessary, explaining that your insurance enrollment is undecided. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今伺った状況を担当者へ伝え、該当する手続きを整理します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will tell the staff what you have just explained and sort out the procedures that apply.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。終わった転入と、まだ確認中の保険を別に印を付けておきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 完了転入と保険確認中を分けて記録したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. I would like to mark the completed move-in registration separately from the insurance that is still being checked.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to record the completed move-in registration separately from the pending insurance check. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 一覧にご自身のメモを残して構いません。未確認の項目を完了としないようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: You may leave your own notes on the list. Please do not mark unchecked items as completed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 転入は済み、保険は確認中とメモしました。この一覧を持って、必要な項目だけ担当と確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 状態別の一覧で該当手続きを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have noted that the move-in registration is complete and the insurance is being checked. I will take this list and check only the applicable items with the staff.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Use the list showing each item's status to check the applicable procedures. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では保険の担当へご案内します。会社へ照会中という点も一緒に伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will take you to the insurance staff now. I will also tell them you are awaiting your company's response.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご予約の変更ですか。診察日をお伺いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you changing your appointment? May I ask your consultation date?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 診察日は変えません。付き添う人が家族から友人に変わるので、そのことを伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 診察維持で同行者のみ交代と訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am not changing the consultation date. The person accompanying me will be a friend instead of a family member, and I want to let you know.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Correct the misunderstanding: the appointment stays the same and only your companion changes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 日時の変更ではなく、同行者の変更ですね。友人の方は通訳もされますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: So the companion is changing, rather than the date or time. Will your friend also interpret?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分からない言葉を助けてもらいます。ただ、検査などの説明は私本人が聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 友人通訳補助と本人説明希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: They will help with words I don't understand. However, I want explanations about tests and such to be given directly to me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your friend will assist with interpreting and that you want explanations yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご本人へ説明します。同行者の方へ伝えてよい内容も、その場で確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will explain things to you directly. We can also check at the time what information we may share with your companion.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。以前は家族に全部話してもらいましたが、今回は私に質問してほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 以前の家族主導から本人質問へ変更を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. Previously, my family member spoke for me about everything, but this time I want you to ask me the questions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for questions to be directed to you instead of having your family take the lead as before. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのご希望を記録します。友人の方の到着は同じ時刻でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will record that preference. Will your friend arrive at the same time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 少し遅れて来ます。友人が来るまで診察を止めてほしいわけではありません。必要なら説明時に相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人遅着と診察停止要求ではないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: They will arrive a little later. I am not asking you to hold up the consultation until my friend arrives. If necessary, I will discuss it when explanations are given.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that your friend will arrive late and that you are not asking to stop the consultation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。遅れて到着した際の合流について、当日受付へお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. Please tell reception on the day about joining up when your friend arrives late.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 日時はそのまま、本人が説明を受け、友人は遅れて通訳を助けます。当日、合流方法を受付で聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 同日時で本人受診と当日合流相談を確定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: The date and time stay the same, I will receive the explanations myself, and my friend will arrive later to help interpret. I will ask reception on the day how we can meet up.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the unchanged appointment, your own consultation, and arranging to meet your friend on the day. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その内容を共有しました。診察の予約は変更していませんので、予定の日時にお越しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I have shared that information. Your consultation booking has not changed, so please come at the scheduled date and time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 自転車が見当たらないご相談ですね。鍵はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are here about a missing bicycle, correct? Do you have the key?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 使っている鍵はあります。でも予備鍵が家にないので、誰かが持ち出したかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 現用鍵所持と予備鍵不明による疑いを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have the key I use. But the spare key is not at home, so someone may have taken it out.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you have your usual key and suspect someone took the spare because its whereabouts are unknown. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予備鍵が見当たらないことと、誰かが持ち出したことは分けて伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will distinguish the missing spare key from whether someone took it out.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうですね。持ち出す所は見ていません。家族に保管場所を聞いてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 持出観察なしと認め家族照会を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: You're right. I didn't see anyone taking it. May I ask my family where it is kept?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Acknowledge that you did not witness it being taken and ask to contact your family. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: どうぞ。自転車を止めた場所と時刻の記録もお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Of course. Please also record where and when you parked the bicycle.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 家族から返事が来ました。予備鍵は家族の引き出しにありました。自転車は昨夜八時、駅前の駐輪場に止めています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家族確認で予備鍵の所在を訂正し駐輪の日時場所も答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: My family has replied. The spare key was in a family member's drawer. I parked the bicycle at the bicycle parking area in front of the station at eight last night.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Correct the spare key's whereabouts after checking with family, and give the parking date, time, and place. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 予備鍵の所在は確認できましたね。自転車も見つかったのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: So the spare key's whereabouts have been confirmed. Has the bicycle also been found?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自転車はまだありません。鍵があったことだけで、紛失の相談を取り消すつもりはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 鍵発見と自転車未発見を分け相談継続を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: The bicycle is still missing. I do not intend to cancel my missing-bicycle inquiry just because the key was found.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish finding the key from the still-missing bicycle and say you want to continue the inquiry. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かりました。鍵の情報を訂正して、駐輪場所と自転車の情報を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. I will correct the key information and ask about the parking location and bicycle.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 知らない人が予備鍵を持っているという話は撤回します。自転車は見当たらないので、登録の書類と駐輪の記録で相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 第三者持出疑いを撤回し登録と駐輪で報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I withdraw my statement that a stranger has the spare key. Since the bicycle is missing, I will use the registration documents and parking record for this inquiry.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Withdraw your suspicion that a third party took the key and report using registration and parking records. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 予備鍵はご家族が保管していると訂正しました。自転車が見当たらない件は、駅前での駐輪の記録と登録資料で担当へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I have corrected the record to say your family keeps the spare key. I will refer the missing-bicycle matter to the staff with the station parking record and registration documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 先ほどの発送についてでしょうか。控えをお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about the item you just mailed? Do you have the receipt?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。出した後、添付する紙が一枚かばんに残っていると気付きました。封筒を戻して入れられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 発送後添付漏れと封筒取戻しを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. After mailing it, I noticed that one sheet I was supposed to enclose was still in my bag. Can I get the envelope back and put it in?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about an omitted enclosure discovered after mailing and retrieving the envelope. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 受付後の取戻しが可能か、状況の確認が必要です。こちらの控えを拝見します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: We need to check the situation to see whether retrieval is possible after acceptance. Let me see your receipt.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: お願いします。自分で発送用の箱から取ってはいけないですよね。もう触っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分で受付箱へ触れず職員確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Please do. I must not take it out of the mailing box myself, right? I haven't touched it since.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask the staff to check without touching the collection box yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。職員が確認します。漏れた書類は提出先へ別に送れる物ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Correct. A staff member will check. Can the missing document be sent separately to the recipient?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだ聞いていません。取戻しだけに頼らず、提出先へ同封漏れを連絡したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 提出先未照会と代替の連絡を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I haven't asked yet. Rather than relying only on retrieval, I want to contact the recipient about the missing enclosure.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have not checked with the recipient and choose to contact them as an alternative. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その連絡も進めてください。取戻しについては今確認しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please go ahead with that contact too. We are checking about retrieval now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 会社に聞けました。別便で送って、最初の申請と分かるメモを付けてほしいそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 別送と関連メモの会社指示を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I was able to ask the company. They want me to send it separately with a note identifying it as part of the original application.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report the company's instructions to mail it separately with a linking note. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 別便で出される場合は、宛先と中身を確認して受付します。最初の郵便物の確認結果もお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you send it separately, we will check the address and contents before accepting it. We will also tell you the result of checking the first mailing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 会社の指示で別便を準備します。最初の封筒を必ず戻せるとは考えず、控えを残して二つの発送を管理します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 取戻し保証を求めず二便控え管理で別送を準備する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will prepare a separate mailing as instructed by the company. I won't assume the first envelope can definitely be retrieved; I will keep the receipts and track both mailings.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Prepare the separate mailing and manage both receipts without requesting guaranteed retrieval. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では最初の郵便物の確認を終えてから、別便の受付をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will finish checking the first item and then explain how to send the separate mailing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 新しい口座の申込みですね。ご案内した持ち物はそろっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are applying for a new account, correct? Do you have all the items we told you to bring?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 身分証はありますが、印鑑はありません。海外では署名だけだったので、気にしていませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 身分証のみで印鑑不足と海外署名経験を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have identification, but no personal seal. Overseas, I only needed a signature, so I hadn't thought about it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you have identification but no seal, and that you used signatures overseas. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらで今回のお申込みに必要な物と、対応できる方法を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will check what is needed for this application and what methods we can offer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。署名でよいと勝手に書かず、案内を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 署名可と断定せず今回の方法説明を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Thank you. I want to hear your guidance rather than filling it in on my own assumption that a signature is acceptable.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Request an explanation of the method for this application without assuming a signature is allowed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今回の窓口での申込みは、この持ち物の案内になります。別の申込み方法にも条件があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: For this application at the counter, these are the items to bring. Other application methods have conditions too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 会社に今日中の開設を頼まれていますが、不足したまま無理に進めるのはやめます。案内を持ち帰れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 会社当日希望より不足解消を優先し案内持帰りを頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: My company has asked me to open the account today, but I will not force the process through with missing items. May I take the guidance home?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Prioritize obtaining missing items over your company's same-day request, and ask to take the guidance home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お渡しできます。必要な物を準備してからご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, you may. Please consult us after preparing the required items.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 会社には今日は完了していないと伝えます。明日来る前に、案内の物を全部確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 会社へ未完了と伝え再来前の確認をする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will tell my company it was not completed today. Before coming tomorrow, I want to check every item in the guidance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Tell your company it is unfinished and check the requirements before returning. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご本人の状況によって追加の確認もありますので、今日のお持ち物について記録しておきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: There may be additional checks depending on your circumstances, so let's record what you brought today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日持ってきた書類を見ていただき、足りない物をメモします。明日は準備してから、改めて申込みを相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 持参済みと不足を分け明日準備後再相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please look at the documents I brought today, and I will note what is missing. Tomorrow, after preparing everything, I will consult you again about applying.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Separate what you brought from what is missing, and consult again tomorrow after preparing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、持ち物の一覧を一緒に確認します。本日開設済みという扱いにはなりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let's go through the checklist together. Your account will not be treated as opened today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 値札を差し替えているところです。商品についてお尋ねでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: We are replacing the price labels. Do you have a question about a product?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 同じ棚に二つの値段が見えます。今買うならどちらになるか、会計の前に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 貼替中二価格の適用を支払前に質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I can see two prices on the same shelf. Before paying, I want to check which would apply if I buy it now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask which of the two prices applies during label replacement, before paying. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 商品の種類と値札の対象を確認します。お選びの物はこちらですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check the product type and which item the label covers. This is the one you selected, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、この一袋です。下の安い表示を見ましたが、隣の商品用かもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 選んだ規格を示し安値が別商品か認める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, this one bag. I saw the cheaper label below, but it may be for the product next to it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the selected size or type and acknowledge the lower price may be for another product. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その表示は隣の規格です。こちらの商品は、今差し替えている値札の対象です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: That label is for the adjacent size. This product is covered by the label we are replacing now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。安いほうが必ず使えるとは言わないようにします。今の価格を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 誤主張を避け当該価格を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I won't insist that the cheaper price must apply. Please tell me the current price.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Avoid making an incorrect claim and ask for this item's price. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの価格です。表示を整えてから、レジでも一致しているか確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: This is its price. After fixing the display, I will check that the register price matches too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 予算より高いので、この袋はやめます。隣の少量の物なら、下の表示の対象ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 予算超過から少量の対象価格を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: It is over my budget, so I won't take this bag. Is the smaller quantity next to it covered by the label below?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Since it exceeds your budget, check the applicable price for the smaller quantity. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 商品番号が一致しています。こちらの少量の商品を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: The product numbers match. Please check this smaller-quantity product.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 番号と価格を見ました。少量のほうに変えて、最初の袋は戻します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 番号価格一致の少量品へ変更する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have checked the number and price. I will switch to the smaller quantity and put the first bag back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Switch to the smaller item whose number and price match. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: そちらで承ります。表示が分かりにくかった点は、売場で整えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will proceed with that one. We will correct the confusing display on the sales floor.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: そろそろ閉園のご案内をしています。お帰りの道は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: We are starting to announce that the park will close soon. Do you know your way back?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: もう一か所見たかったのですが、車まで戻る時間も必要ですね。駐車場が二つあるようで迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 閉園時間と二駐車場の迷いを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wanted to see one more place, but I need time to return to my car too. There seem to be two parking lots, and I am unsure which one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about closing time and your uncertainty between two parking lots. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お車を止めた時の目印は覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you remember any landmark from when you parked?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 入口の横に大きな案内板がありました。それだけでは、どちらか決められませんよね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 共通案内板だけの目印では不確実と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: There was a large information board beside the entrance. That alone doesn't tell us which one, does it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that an information board common to both entrances is an uncertain landmark. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 両方に案内板があります。入口名の写真や駐車券などはありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Both have information boards. Do you have a photo of the entrance name or a parking ticket?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 入口を撮った写真があります。ここの名前が写っていました。いま近い駐車場とは別です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 入口写真で自分の駐車場を特定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have a photo of the entrance. Its name is visible here. It is different from the parking lot nearest us now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Identify your parking lot from the entrance photo. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そちらへはこの園路で戻ります。閉園までの時間を考えて、そのままお戻りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Take this park path back there. Considering the time until closing, please head straight back.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。見たかった場所へ寄らず、車へ戻ります。友人も車で待っているので、遅くならないよう連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 追加見学をやめ車へ直行し待つ友人へ連絡する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I'll go back to the car without visiting the other place. My friend is waiting in the car too, so I'll contact them and make sure I don't get back late.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give up further sightseeing, go straight to the car, and contact your waiting friend. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この分岐で入口名をもう一度確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Check the entrance name again at this fork.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 写真の入口へ、分岐の表示を見て戻ります。友人に今から直行すると伝えました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 分岐表示で実入口を再確認して戻る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will follow the signs at the fork back to the entrance in the photo. I have told my friend I am going straight there now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Recheck the actual entrance using the fork's signs and return. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、そのままお進みください。次回、時間に余裕のある時に続きをご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please continue that way. See the rest next time when you have more time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 乗り換えのご案内ですか。どちらまで行かれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you need transfer directions? Where are you going?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私は東京方面、友人は反対の高崎方面です。途中まで同じ列車で行けると思ったのですが。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二人の行き先が違うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am heading toward Tokyo, and my friend is going the opposite way toward Takasaki. I thought we could take the same train part of the way.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the two of you have different destinations. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: はい、次の乗換駅まで同じ列車で行けます。その先で分かれます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Yes, you can take the same train to the next transfer station. You will split up after that.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 次の駅で二人とも降りるんですね。降りたら、同じホームの両側に分かれればいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 次の駅で二人とも降り、同じホームの両側に分かれればよいか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: So we both get off at the next station. After getting off, should we just go to opposite sides of the same platform?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that both of you should get off at the next station, and ask whether you should then go to opposite sides of the same platform.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: いいえ。東京方面は上の連絡通路を渡ります。高崎方面は降りたホームで表示を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: No. For Tokyo, cross the overhead connecting passage. For Takasaki, check the signs on the platform where you get off.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、友人まで私について通路を渡ると、違う方向へ行ってしまうんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 友人も自分について連絡通路を渡ると、違う方向へ行ってしまうことを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then if my friend follows me across the passage too, they will end up going in the wrong direction.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that if your friend follows you across the connecting passage, they will go in the wrong direction.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そうです。ホーム中央の階段の前で、二人の経路を確認してから分かれると分かりやすいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: That's right. It will be easier if you check both routes in front of the stairs in the middle of the platform before splitting up.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: そこで別れることにします。私は階段を上がり、友人はホームに残って高崎方面の表示を見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 別れる場所を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: We will part there. I will go up the stairs, and my friend will stay on the platform and check the signs for Takasaki.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide where to split up. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。ホーム番号は当日の案内で変わる場合がありますので、方向と行き先も見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Platform numbers may change according to the day's announcements, so also check the direction and destination.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 番号だけではなく、私と友人がそれぞれ自分の行き先を確認してから乗ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 各自で表示を確認する手順を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: My friend and I will each check our own destination before boarding, rather than checking only the number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain the procedure for each person to check the signs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その手順でどうぞ。まずは、この列車で二人とも次の乗換駅までお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please follow that procedure. First, both of you should take this train to the next transfer station.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どの証明書をご希望ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会社から住所の証明を持ってくるように言われました。でも、書類の正式な名前は聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 提出先の依頼を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: My company told me to bring proof of my address. But I have not asked for the document's official name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain what the organization receiving it requested. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 「住所の証明」だけでは種類を決められません。会社からの案内はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: We cannot determine the type from just “proof of address.” Do you have instructions from your company?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 口頭で言われただけです。今、会社へ電話して確認してもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 依頼は口頭だけだったと伝え、今会社へ電話して確認してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: They only told me verbally. May I phone the company now to check?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the request was only given verbally, and ask whether you may call your company now to check.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: どうぞ。必要な証明書名と、記載してほしい項目を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Of course. Check the name of the required certificate and the details they want included.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私一人の情報なのか、家族も載せるのかも聞いた方がいいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分一人の情報だけか、家族も記載するのかを会社へ確認すべきか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I should also ask whether it should show only my information or include my family too, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether you should also check with your company if the document should show only your information or include your family as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。提出先の指定が分かれば、その内容でこちらの申請をご案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Once you know the recipient's requirements, we can guide you through an application here based on them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 担当者が席を外していて、返事は午後になるそうです。今は申請書を出さずに待ちたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 担当者が不在で回答は午後になると伝え、今は申請書を出さずに待ちたいと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: The person in charge is away from their desk, and I am told the answer will come this afternoon. I would like to wait without submitting an application form now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the person responsible is away and the answer will come this afternoon. Explain that you would like to wait without submitting the application form now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。回答を聞いてから、正式名称をこの案内と照らし合わせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. Once you receive the answer, compare the official name with this guide.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 名称と記載項目をメモしてから戻ります。「住所の証明」という言い方だけで選ばないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 名称が分かってから申請すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will return after noting the name and required details. I won't choose based only on the phrase “proof of address.”
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will apply after finding out the name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。本日は案内をお渡しします。確認できましたら、改めて窓口へお越しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. We will give you the guide today. Please return to the counter once you have confirmed it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 問診票の「いつから」の欄には、今日と書かれていますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You wrote “today” in the “since when” section of the medical questionnaire.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今日はつらくなった日です。少し気になり始めた日も、ここに書くのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 開始時期の質問を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Today is when it became distressing. Should I also write when I first began to notice it a little?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Clarify the question about the starting time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: はい。最初に気付いた時期と、その後の変化が分かるようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Yes. Please make clear when you first noticed it and how it changed afterward.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 最初は三日前の夕方です。その時は少し気になる程度で、今日の朝から強く感じています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 最初に気付いた日を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I first noticed it in the evening three days ago. It only bothered me a little then, but it has felt much worse since this morning.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say which day you first noticed it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 三日前の夕方に始まり、今朝強くなったのですね。時刻まで覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: So it began in the evening three days ago and became stronger this morning. Do you remember the exact time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 三日前は帰宅後なので、六時ごろだと思います。正確な時刻は覚えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 三日前の帰宅後、六時ごろだと思うが、正確な時刻は覚えていないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Three days ago it was after I got home, so I think around six. I do not remember the exact time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that it was after you got home three days ago, so you think it was around six, but you do not remember the exact time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 「夕方ごろ」と書いて大丈夫です。覚えていないところを無理に確定しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Writing “around the evening” is fine. Do not force yourself to specify something you don't remember.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、「三日前の夕方から、今朝から強くなった」と書き直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 三日前の夕方に始まり、今朝から強くなったという二つの時期を、問診票に書き直すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I will change it to “since the evening three days ago; became stronger this morning.”
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will revise the questionnaire to show both time points: it started in the evening three days ago and became stronger this morning.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。診察でも、その順でお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Please tell the doctor in that order too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 書き直しました。今日だけで急に始まったわけではないことが、これで伝わりますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 問診票を書き直したと伝え、今日突然始まったわけではないことが伝わるか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have corrected it. This makes it clear that it did not suddenly start only today, doesn't it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have corrected the questionnaire, and check whether it now makes clear that the problem did not suddenly begin today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。記入した経過をお預かりして、診察の担当者へ渡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. We will take your recorded history and pass it to the person handling your consultation.
